shulkerpalette.panel.power.on: Palette on. Click to turn it off and use this box as storage.
shulkerpalette.panel.power.off: Palette off. Click to build from this box.
shulkerpalette.panel.mode.random: Random, weighted by count. Click for the next mode.
shulkerpalette.panel.mode.equal: Random, every block type equally. Click for the next mode.
shulkerpalette.panel.mode.pick: Pick one block (%s + scroll). Click for the next mode.
shulkerpalette.panel.mode.gradient: Gradient: random from one row (%s + scroll). Click for the next mode.
shulkerpalette.panel.repaint.on: Repaint on: right-click replaces the block you look at.
shulkerpalette.panel.repaint.off: Repaint off. Click to replace blocks instead of placing.
shulkerpalette.panel.save: Save this palette to your library.
shulkerpalette.panel.load: Load a palette from your library. In creative it fills the box. In survival it shows what goes where.
shulkerpalette.config.title: Shulker Palette
shulkerpalette.config.modifier.descripti: Hold it with a palette in hand: scroll to pick a block or a gradient row and see the box, right-click a block to place the box itself, right-click the air to open it.
shulkerpalette.config.repaint.descriptio: Turns repaint on or off for the palette in your hand, without opening it. Creative only.
shulkerpalette.config.keybinds.descripti: Opens Minecraft's key binds. Shulker Palette's keys are under Shulker Palette: the palette modifier (Left Alt, Option on a Mac), Toggle palette and Toggle repaint (both unbound).
shulkerpalette.config.rainbow.descriptio: The cycling outline around the next block, in the modes that pick at random.
shulkerpalette.config.popup.description: Shows the box above your hotbar while you hold the palette modifier and scroll. Off, scrolling still picks, and the action bar names what you picked.
shulkerpalette.config.open_box.descripti: In your hand, the open box with the next block inside. Off, your hand shows only the next block.
shulkerpalette.config.power.description: Turns the shulker in your hand into a palette, or back into plain storage, without opening it.
shulkerpalette.panel.rows.more: Rows: %s of %s. Click to add a row.
shulkerpalette.panel.rows.less: Rows: %s of %s. Click to take away the last row (only when it's empty).
shulkerpalette.config.library.descriptio: Rename, move and delete your saved palettes, and copy them to or from the clipboard.
shulkerpalette.library.title: Palette library
shulkerpalette.library.save.title: Save palette
shulkerpalette.library.replace.title: Replace %s?
shulkerpalette.library.replace.body: A palette with this name is already saved there.
shulkerpalette.library.save_failed: Couldn't save the palette. The game log says why.
shulkerpalette.library.empty_box: Nothing to save. The box is empty.
shulkerpalette.library.load.title: Load a palette
shulkerpalette.library.no_world: Open a world to see its palettes.
shulkerpalette.library.paste.tooltip: Adds the palette on the clipboard to this tab.
shulkerpalette.library.status.name_taken: A palette with that name is already there
shulkerpalette.panel.rows.less.label: − Row
shulkerpalette.panel.rows.more.label: + Row
